decisions.reason: After another year of learning, the fifteen-day express program appears too weakly differentiated from the broader express portfolio, so we would consolidate resources into stronger express and core offers.
The seventy-two-hour program builds directly on existing production, scheduling, and service capabilities and remains a distinctive premium offer the firm can continue to refine.
The fire-resistant steel exterior door sits firmly in the firm's established fire-protection, certification, and engineering knowledge base, making retention very likely.
The wider express delivery line for doors and gates fits the core business well and gives management enough scale and feedback to improve the range rather than withdraw it.
The fire and smoke protection door is highly complementary to the firm's compliance, installation, and maintenance strengths, so it remains a strong candidate for continued development.
